doc: Pieces of "I'm Just Supporting a Friend" (scripts/tup-prep.py). Every number is in px of the piece's own png (x right, y down); ox, oy = where the piece's top left was in its 1344x768 picture. bowl: rim = [cx, cy, rx, ry] of the ellipse of its far rim (the lip), rimFront = the y of that ellipse's lowest point, pivot = the middle of the foot, width = the lip's widest. lid: already resampled to sit on the bowl at scale 1 (resampled = the factors); centre, rx, ry = its top ellipse, bottom = its lowest edge, seat = where the lid png's top left goes in the bowl png's px so that the lid sits on the bowl (the two top ellipses coincide; the lid's skirt then covers the lip), pressEdge = where the shopper's fingertip lands (on the lid, near its right edge), pressMiddle = where the hostess's does (on the dimple). handShopper, handHostess: tip = the fingertip, fingerW = the finger's width 35 px above it (the two hands are drawn at one scale), side = where the sleeve comes in from, cut = [x, y0, y1] the edge it is cut off by (keep it off screen). handMan: box = the box's bounding box, boxBottom = the middle of its bottom edge, grip = where the skin touches it, cut as above. giftBox: pivot = the middle of its bottom edge, box = its bounding box, scaleInHand = the scale that makes it the box in the man's hand (put its pivot on handMan.boxBottom).
